title: HED schema library for SCORE annotations example
description: This BIDS example dataset contains intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from a single subject collected during clinical photic stimulation at Mayo Clinic. It demonstrates the use of the HED-SCORE (Standardized Computer-based Organized Reporting of EEG) schema library for annotating events in a machine-readable, BIDS- and HED-validated format, supporting standardized event annotation practices in EEG/iEEG research.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG data were collected from one subject during clinical photic stimulation at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, MN, under IRB approval (IRB#: 15-006530). Events were annotated using the HED-SCORE schema library, with annotation columns added to the _events.tsv files and corresponding HED tag definitions provided in the _events.json sidecar files.
